description:
Adds various salt-related items and blocks.

# VoxeLibre Salt (`mcl_salt`)

Adds salt ore, underground salt chambers, decorative salt blocks, snow and ice melting mechanisms and salted foods.


## Features

### Worldgen

- Salt Ore and Deepslate Salt Ore spawn under the surface and can be mined to drop Salt
- Salt Chambers are large geode-like structures rarely generated underground. These naturally generate:
  - Rock Salt as walls
  - Salt Crystal formations on the floor and ceiling
  - Loose Salt deposits

### Uses

Salt and Loose Salt can be used to melt Snow Block, Snow Layers and Ice.
All salt-related blocks deal damage to Slimes when near.
Salt can also be used as a decorative building material, but be careful: salt blocks dissolve when exposed to water!

### Building Materials

- Salt Block
- Salt Bricks
- Salt Pillar
- Salt Slab
- Salt Stairs
- Chiseled Salt
- Salt Lamp

### Food

- Salted foods with improved saturation
  - Salted Steak
  - Salted Chicken
  - Salted Porkchop
  - Salted Mutton
  - Salted Rabbit
  - Salted Fish
  - Salted Salmon
  - Salted Baked Potato
- Rotten Flesh can be salted to create Cured Flesh


*ChatGPT was used as assistance while coding. All AI-generated code is understood by me as well.*
